entries.headline: One late-day XLRE paper reclaim passed every hard gate; it is a mechanism sample, not proof of edge.
thoughts: The broad IEX-only screen found concentrated energy leadership and several chase-heavy movers, not broad confirmation. XLRE supplied a completed 15-minute structure-and-VWAP reclaim with acceptable displayed liquidity and exact minimum reward-to-risk geometry.
XLRE had no symbol-specific catalyst or relative-strength edge. It lagged both the broad market and the leading energy sector, so this is a pure pooled mechanism sample rather than an alpha claim.
XLP and PFE showed similar defensive reclaims, but adding either would duplicate the same late-day factor. One position is enough to test this mechanism; a second would manufacture diversification.

Risk appetite remains an owner preference, not evidence. Aggressive sizing is still locked, dead triggers cannot be revived, and every new strategy idea remains PAPER or shadow-only until its frozen sample and matched-control gates are met.
The broker and durable ledger were reconciled after the close. XLRE is the only open position across all basis epochs; no prior-epoch position was omitted.

public_entry_reviews.result: Publication safety passed. Strategy opinion: XLRE is a low-information, macro-contaminated reclaim sample whose best use is testing stop-distance and gap-through realism, not proving continuation edge.
Publication safety passed. Strategy opinion: the trade is defensible as one paper sample, but the executable book remains reclaim monoculture with zero resolved family evidence.

fable.result: Keep cross-sectional multi-week momentum shadow-only, tag scheduled macro contamination, audit narrow-stop gap losses, and score rejected same-family duplicates prospectively.

grok.result: Keep causal implied-move and pooled-reclaim audits shadow-only, preserve the monoculture warning, and do not promote or unlock size.

changes_after_grok: Position return, per-position contribution, and single-position aggregate marks now use coarse percentage bands so relative or dollar sizing cannot be reconstructed.
Scheduled-macro contamination and gap-through loss realism are frozen as measurement-only audits with finite sample and kill rules.
Rejected same-family candidates and multi-week momentum are frozen as prospective shadow experiments; no outcome was backfilled.
Session-clock and leader-versus-laggard tags remain measurement-only inside the pooled reclaim family.
The reviewers disagree on whether XLRE is primarily low-information macro contamination or defensible sampling; both opinions remain preserved, and neither changes the bracket or hard gates.

entries.headline: Cash beat every researched entry; the open PLTR winner remains bracketed, concentrated, and near its target.
thoughts: Late-Friday risk-on tape did not justify chasing. QNST and TEAM were far outside the frozen no-chase rule, while XLK, XLV, and TTD produced no valid fresh trigger.

PLTR remains the only open position. The original thesis is intact, but current reward remaining versus stop distance is poor and the book has one dominant high-beta factor exposure with no offsetting sleeve.
NO_TRADE is a decision, not inactivity. Cash won because no candidate passed evidence, entry, liquidity, and reward-to-risk gates.

The owner set paper risk appetite to 7/10 and authorized a 20% aggregate managed-risk ceiling with no separate aggressive-position cap. That is preference, not proven edge; per-trade aggressive sizing stays locked behind a 20-trade, +0.30R evidence gate.
